milestone: Phase C: Authorized Live Weather and Rainfall Integration
overall_status_narrative: Operational meteorological ingestion pipeline fully implemented, tested, and integrated. Zero synthetic dry rainfall baseline enforced; unit/timestamp normalization verified; five-signal forecast evidence separation maintained without inferring flooding from forecast alone; routing safety invariant verified; live external provider access remains BLOCKED pending institutional data-sharing MOUs and server-side cryptographic authentication.

candidate_providers_audit.provider_name: India Meteorological Department (IMD) / MoES AWS Telemetry
candidate_providers_audit.authentication_requirements: Bearer token or API Key via Authorization header (SAHAAY_IMD_API_KEY)
candidate_providers_audit.data_types_and_units: Cumulative gauge counter Ct (mm), interval rainfall (mm/h), air temp (°C)
candidate_providers_audit.station_metadata_coverage: Primary IMD surface observatories across Greater Hyderabad & Telangana
candidate_providers_audit.timestamp_cadence: Hourly / 15-minute telemetry packets; nominal UTC timestamps
candidate_providers_audit.rate_limits_and_outages: Public gateway latency during severe convective events; fail-closed UNKNOWN fallback
candidate_providers_audit.licensing_permitted_uses: Government of India / IMD data policy; operational dispatch requires executed MOU
candidate_providers_audit.access_blocker_reason: No active API base URL or credential configured; institutional MOU pending.

candidate_providers_audit.provider_name: Telangana State Development Planning Society Urban AWS Network
candidate_providers_audit.authentication_requirements: IP Whitelist & Bearer Token issued by state planning directorate
candidate_providers_audit.station_metadata_coverage: ~100 urban telemetry stations within GHMC core zones
candidate_providers_audit.rate_limits_and_outages: Tipping bucket under-catch during intense downpours; electrical disconnect negatives
candidate_providers_audit.licensing_permitted_uses: Government of Telangana; non-commercial research use only
candidate_providers_audit.access_blocker_reason: Bilateral data-sharing MOU pending state department executive sign-off.

candidate_providers_audit.provider_name: IMD Begumpet Doppler Weather Radar (S-Band DWR)
candidate_providers_audit.endpoint: https://mausam.imd.gov.in/radar/ (Public web raster viewer only; zero machine API)
candidate_providers_audit.authentication_requirements: None available for public telemetry; bilateral agreement needed for raw volume scans
candidate_providers_audit.data_types_and_units: Radar reflectivity Z (dBZ), instantaneous QPE rate (mm/h), PAC accumulations
candidate_providers_audit.rate_limits_and_outages: Beam blockage by urban high-rises, attenuation in heavy rain, maintenance downtime
candidate_providers_audit.licensing_permitted_uses: MoES / IMD statutory weather data policy
candidate_providers_audit.access_blocker_reason: No raw telemetry or digital QPE API exists; displays raster image products only.

candidate_providers_audit.provider_name: IMD Regional Numerical Weather Prediction (Regional WRF / GFS)
candidate_providers_audit.data_types_and_units: Quantitative precipitation forecast (QPF) in cumulative mm over 3h/24h intervals
candidate_providers_audit.rate_limits_and_outages: Grid resolution too coarse for street-level underpass waterlogging nowcasts
candidate_providers_audit.access_blocker_reason: Coarse spatial resolution and lack of programmatic JSON API for urban dispatch.

candidate_providers_audit.authentication_requirements: API Key for enterprise SLA; open tier uncalibrated
candidate_providers_audit.timestamp_cadence: Hourly forecasts out to 168 hours; 4 runs daily
candidate_providers_audit.rate_limits_and_outages: Cloud service dependency; uncalibrated against local Hyderabad microclimate
candidate_providers_audit.licensing_permitted_uses: CC BY 4.0 (Open-Meteo); commercial enterprise agreement required for SLA
candidate_providers_audit.access_blocker_reason: Live internet queries prohibited in offline engineering phase; uncalibrated locally.
